shared_elements: vertically stacked motifs arranged in registers on a tall narrow surface
bilateral symmetry about a central axis
curved arc or band spanning the width
raised/incised low-relief carving on a monolithic slab-like form
justification: Both present a tall, narrow field organised into vertically stacked registers with mirrored motifs flanking a central axis, and both include a prominent circular/ring element and broad curved bands near the middle. The decisive differences are in rendering and legibility: A is a crisp pen drawing of clearly identifiable hook-beaked birds and interlaced limbs with dense hatching, whereas B is a weathered, coarsely pecked stone relief whose motifs are abstract, shallow and largely unidentifiable, with no unambiguous animal imagery.
